_meta.description: Task 1.1 (REQ-VBTW-004): a posted ledger line carries the VAT tariff it was booked at, the VAT return box of that tariff (the tariff's `section`) and whether its amount is the base or the VAT, stamped when it is posted. VAT declarations and VAT lines of a prepared return carry the box they belong to. None of the fields is required: lines posted before this change have none until the backfill (task 1.3) stamps them.

vatTariffCode.description: The VatTariff code this line was booked at (for example high, low, reverse-charge). Set when the line is posted from a document line that has a tariff.
vatTariffCode.title: VAT tariff

vatReturnBox.description: The box of the VAT return this line counts in: the tariff's section for sales and reverse-charged purchases, 5b for input VAT. Empty for a line that is in no box, such as the base of an ordinary purchase.
vatReturnBox.title: VAT return box

vatAmountKind.description: Whether this line's amount is the base the VAT is charged on (the revenue or cost line) or the VAT itself (the line on the output or input VAT account).
vatAmountKind.title: VAT amount kind

returnBox.description: The VAT return box this declaration totals.
returnBox.title: Return box

returnBox.description: The VAT return box of the ledger line this VAT line was taken from.
returnBox.title: Return box
